theorem_natural_language_statement:
Let actual left and right arrays and their original-index residue buckets be stored, together with the selected occurrence row and complete local-cover data. Fix global output $q$, a prefix at depth $k\le J$, and original $A$ value $a$. Assume all retained inputs precede the ordered mask, endpoint, flag, bit, and arithmetic scratch buffers; the specified terminal space, word, address, and depth bounds hold; values, $a$, targets $a+b_i$, and the pair-count bound fit words. The closed terminal program returns a Boolean equal to the exact terminal-batch hit predicate in its stated time and preserves every input cell before the mask region.

Executes complete original-value terminal verification from concrete retained data. This supports the complete deterministic integer 3SUM runtime proof.
